name: Boogie synth slap
desc: Early-80s boogie synth bass in Bb mixolydian: rubbery thumbed roots with a pitch-envelope snap on the octave pops, dead 16th ghosts, chromatic slide into the four. Cameo and Zapp school - Minneapolis pocket at 113 BPM.

code.full: stack(note("<[bb1 ~ bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ ~ ab1 ~ g1 ~ a1 ~] [bb1 ~ bb1 ~ ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ ~ db2 ~ c2 ~ eb2 ~]>").lpf(700).lpq(4).decay(.14).sustain(.1).shape(.45).gain(${gain}), note("[~ ~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ ~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ bb2 ~]").penv(${snap}).pdec(.04).lpf(1700).hpf(170).decay(.09).sustain(0).shape(.4).gain(${gain}*.75)).add(note(${root})).s("square").room(.06).every(8, x=>x.add(note(2))).orbit(3).play()
code.peak: stack(note("<[bb1 ~ bb1 bb1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ab1 ~ g1 ~ a1 ~] [bb1 ~ bb1 bb1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 db2 ~ c2 eb2 f2 ~]>").lpf(800).lpq(4).decay(.13).sustain(.09).shape(.5).gain(${gain}), note("[~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ bb2 ~ ~ bb2 c3]").penv(${snap}).pdec(.035).lpf(2000).hpf(190).decay(.08).sustain(0).shape(.45).gain(${gain}*.8)).add(note(${root})).s("square").room(.06).every(4, x=>x.add(note("<0 2>"))).orbit(3).play()
